title: Applying the fuzzy distinction method to analyze the precautionary area of the wind farm along the western coast of Taiwan
core_idea: Develop a precautionary area (PA) planning model for western Taiwan offshore wind farms that jointly considers navigational safety, ecological sensitivity, and wind/hydrological factors by integrating AIS ship-navigation data, spatial analysis via a marine GIS, and fuzzy logic control to manage data uncertainties and complexities.
tldr: Proposes a PA planning approach for western Taiwan OWFs combining AIS, MGIS, and fuzzy logic to account for navigation, ecological sensitivity, and environmental factors in PA design.
